title: Guard execution can predate creation, waiting and timer firing
reproduction: Set both completion/final ExecCondition start_time to D-60s, D-28.5s, D-1s or D-6s, retaining guard completion at D+5ms, main start at D+10ms and guard output at D+1ms. Full validation accepts. A separate first-case verified_anchor accepts the D-60s start.
root_cause: The parser brackets guard output by its own interval and orders guard end before main start, but never orders guard start after creation, last never-invoked waiting capture, or trigger; it does not constrain the guard duration to the proposed start budget.
impact: Mutually exclusive NEW/WAITING/EXECUTING states can describe one accepted generation; a stale guard can yield an admissible completed-case anchor.
required_fix: One causal state graph must bind guard launch after timer creation/last never-invoked capture/qualified trigger, with conservative same-domain bounds and a qualified finite start-duration rule. Share that gate for per-case admission, retention and final closure.

title: Plain journal records bypass invocation and sender attribution
reproduction: Append a correctly timed exit0 plain row labelled as UID65534 service output but with malformed or prior-generation _SYSTEMD_INVOCATION_ID, or _SYSTEMD_UNIT=foreign.service plus UNIT=current-owned-service. Full validation accepts after matching the raw receipt and resealing.
root_cause: Only JSON MESSAGE records become bound invocation events. Plain records take an OR over unit fields and ignore present invocation identity; journal_consistency checks message/code/status and UID only.
impact: A favorable exit message can coexist with contradictory raw generation/unit attribution and still produce PASS_CONSISTENCY_ONLY/PASS_SYNTHETIC_ONLY.
required_fix: Define supported manager-versus-service journal record classes using documented fields. Reject contradictory present attribution, malformed invocation IDs and unrelated senders; do not require a service invocation field universally on legitimate PID1 manager records.

title: Retained journal completeness excludes plain diagnostic records
reproduction: Remove the required ModuleNotFoundError plain row from retained missingdep history in rearm-b admission. Preserve original completed case, existing anchor and ledger. Both collision.absent and complete result validation accept the truncated fresh full-journal readback.
root_cause: Anchor events_sha256 hashes selected JSON payload events only. No anchor binds the immutable raw journal prefix/cursors/plain rows, and retained validation does not require previously proved diagnostic rows.
impact: A current claimed complete journal can omit known historical raw evidence without triggering FAIL/BLOCKED, despite the independently sealed anchor.
required_fix: Bind complete immutable journal evidence (including plain records and cursor/record identity) into prior anchors; require monotone preservation across subsequent full captures, with an explicit fail-closed policy for journal rotation/truncation. Do not delete or silently reseal missing records.
